Docket is a marketplace for tech work only: website builds, IT help desk, networking, databases and custom apps. Companies describe the job and a budget range, providers send quotes, and you accept the one that fits.

How a job moves

  1. Open

    Spec the jobOpen

    Say what needs doing, pick a category, and give a budget range.

  2. Awaiting decision

    Quotes landAwaiting decision

    Providers send a price and a short note on how they'd do it.

  3. Accepted

    Accept oneAccepted

    Each quote sits on your budget line. Accept the one that fits.

  4. In progress

    Work startsIn progress

    The job moves to in progress and comes off the open jobs list.

If you need the work done

  • Describe the job in plain language. No spec document needed.
  • Set a budget range so quotes land in the right ballpark.
  • See every quote plotted against your budget.
  • Accept one and the job moves to in progress.
Post a job

If you do the work

  • Only tech jobs. No logo contests, no data entry.
  • Scan category, budget and age before you open a job.
  • Quote your price with a note on how you'd do it.
  • Solo freelancers and small teams quote on the same terms.
